notes.title: ACHIEVMENT UPDATE TEST
notes.content: I am publishing updates once or twice a day for a bit under the [Update Test] - beta to test and fully implement at least 16 achievements and adding an options menu to change between full screen and windowed along with a v sync option to fix an fps issue with high refresh rate monitors. you can join in by switching your game beta by, right clicking the game through steam, clicking properties, and changing the game beta to [update test]. To all who have stayed for the ride since release, thank you!

tags.feature: adding an options menu to change between full screen and windowed along with a v sync option to fix an fps issue with high refresh rate monitors.
